description: The Nerve Center: BrainChain (docs.usebrainchain.com) is the Upper City's nervous system. Returns BrainChain's counters (jobs posted, paid, refunded, decisions, USDG paid to workers), its latest decisions with Jev's confidence and the bar the chain needs (70 for a grade or ruling), and optionally a wallet's record (give wallet) and the Tokyo job lines written on the NerveCenterLink contract on Robinhood Chain (give job). Free, read only. Every number is read from a chain; if a read fails the answer says so. Jev grades the work a BrainChain model delivers, so a line for a Tokyo job is the grade of a second-opinion task, not a certification of the original report.

job.description: A Tokyo job id: returns the BrainChain lines linked to it

wallet.description: 0x wallet address: returns what it posted and earned on BrainChain

name: nerve_center
